syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (ELEC semester 5): Analog and Digital Communication Laboratory
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics copied from the course handout PDF (pages 14 of ELEC/sem5/Electrical_Semester_5_Course_Handout.pdf). New in Prism: no curated sources or checked lessons yet.

topics.name: To observe the double sided full carrier AM waveform and calculate the depth of modulation (Modulation Index) also observe the AM detection using diode detector circuit.
To observe the FM waveform and to measure peak frequency deviation for 2V peak to peak modulating signal also observe the FM detection using PLL detector.
To observe the frequency response of the Pre-emphasis and de-emphasis circuits.
To observe the generation of SSB signal using balance modulator and single sideband filter.
To observe the demodulation of SSB signal using diode detector and product modulator.
To study PAM, PWM and PPM modulation and demodulation and also sketch the output waveform.
To observe the working of Radio receiver and analyze the significance of the AGC circuit.
To study the output of the Sample and Hold circuit and it’s reconstruction at 4KHz sampling frequency (to analyze the Nyquist Rate/ Criteria)
To understand the concept of PCM and observe the PCM waveforms.
To understand the concept of Delta modulation and achieve delta modulation and demodulation.
To study the ASK modulation and demodulation also to sketch the modulated and demodulated waveforms.
To study the FSK modulation and demodulation also to sketch the modulated and demodulated waveforms.
To study the PSK modulation and demodulation also to sketch the modulated and demodulated waveforms.
To study the QPSK modulation and demodulation also to sketch the modulated and demodulated waveforms. .
